description: This Java source file defines a fragment class LogFragment that manages a user interface component displaying log messages through a custom LogView. The class creates and configures the view hierarchy programmatically, including a ScrollView and a LogView, and updates the scroll position when new log data is appended.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that provides a user interface for displaying log messages via a LogView inside a ScrollView.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures a ScrollView containing a LogView, setting layout parameters, padding, and appearance.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, adds a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on new log entries, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
